purpose.zh: 在拉长的位置加强大腿前侧
purpose.en: Strengthen the front of your thighs while they are stretched.

text.zh: 膝到肩一条直线，往后倒到能控制的程度
text.en: Keep knees to shoulders in one line and lean back only as far as you control

text.zh: 跪直夹紧臀部，双手交叉放在胸前。
text.en: Kneel tall, squeeze your glutes and cross your arms on your chest.

text.zh: 髋部别弯，整个人一起回正。
text.en: Do not bend at the hips; come back up in one piece.

commonErrors.en: Bending at the hips and sitting back.
Leaning back too far to come back up.

cautions.zh: 膝前不舒服时少倒一点，膝下加垫
cautions.en: If the front of your knee feels uncomfortable, lean back less and pad under your knees.

changes: 改名：「反向北欧」听不懂 → 跪姿身体后倾 / Kneeling Lean-Back
cue3「不在髋处折叠」改「髋部别弯」，error「屈髋后坐」改「弯髋往后坐」
